fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The aim of this major is to cultivate high-level talents. This program provides talents to serve for the region's foreign economic relations, foreign trade, foreign investment, and the strategy of "going out". The major combines international economics and trade theories, policies with business practices closely. Students are required broader knowledge theoretically and politically along with better English skill and operational international trade ability. 2. The Model of the Program Editor Notes: The model of this program is 2+2. It takes 4-6 years to complete this program generally. International students can start their major directly after they come to China. In the first two years the courses are delivered in English while in the last two years international students take classes with Chinese peers for Chinese-medium courses. 3. Internship Editor Notes: Internship in companies are provided in this program. Students can have up to 12-weeks internship in companies under the guidance of professors. 4. Language Requirement Editor Notes: International students are required to pass HSK 4 before graduation. English-speaking international students don't need pass HSK (Chinese proficiency test) to start degree programs. However they need to pass HSK 4 at the end of second year of their degree programs. 5. Main Research Fields Editor Notes: There are 3 kinds of research fields in this program. 1.International economics trade theory and policy (1) International service trade (2) New theories of international economics and trade (3) Trade and environment (4) Multinational companies and international trade 2.Forestry products trade (1)International trade practice of forestry products (2) Forestry products trade theories 3.International trade practice 6. Introduction of Zhejiang A & F University Editor Notes: The first employment rate of undergraduate students is always more than 90% and in the forefront of Zhejiang universities. Founded in 1958, Zhejiang A & F University (ZAFU) is a comprehensive university directly under the auspices of Zhejiang Province offering Bachelor and Masters degrees in agriculture, technology, science, literature, management, law, economics, medicine, etc. and enrolling international students. ZAFU, located in Lin'an City (west of the popular tourist destination Hangzhou) has Yijin and East Lake campuses covering almost 167 hectares with 550,000 square meters of building space. Its modern buildings and facilities in a setting of great natural beauty, surrounded by mountains and water, make ZAFU a most suitable place for learning, teaching, and conducting research. The campus combined with the botanical garden comprise an ecological environment with functions of teaching, scientific research, and biodiversity conservation. Learn More>> 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: Different kinds of activities are waiting international students to explore. International Students Attend Tea Culture Activity ​​ The First ZAFU IC Model United Nations Meeting ​​​

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) * 2. Passport photo Format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB. * 3. Police Certificate within one year It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. * 4. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 5. Certificate of High school Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 6. Academic Transcripts of High school Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. 7. Transfer letter from last school include the attendance and performance For the transferred students who have already studied in China. 8. Certificate of verification from Entry-Exit inspection and Quarantine within 6 months For the transferred students who have already studied in China. * 9. Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. Commitment without Drug Use History Must be submitted with handwritten signature 11. Other certificates or documents * 12. A Short Video of Self Introduction A Short Video of Self Introduction, at least 2 minutes * 13. Family Information Form You can download a template or sample from here . * 14. Financial Income Statement 15. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Non-Chinese citizens; No criminal record; Be in good health; High school graduate or above. Age 18-28 years old. English proficiency certificate. Note: Applicant should be non-Chinese citizens with valid regular foreign passport and be friendly to China;*Residents of China who have emigrated to a foreign country and who are now applying to study in China as international students must have held a valid foreign passport for at least 4 years, and must have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30, 2020). (9 months of residence in a foreign country may count as a full year. The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence).
